_comment: Free-tier limits copied from the AI Studio rate-limit page (2026-09-23). Each model has its OWN daily bucket. 'display' is the AI Studio name and is used to look up the real API id via models.list(); 'id' is the fallback if the lookup fails. Quotas reset at midnight Pacific. routing lists, per task, which models to try in order. OpenRouter entries use 'pick' (preferred name fragments) instead of a fixed id, because the ':free' list changes; 'providers' holds account-wide limits (OpenRouter: 50 free requests/day, 1000 after a lifetime $10 top-up).

routing._comment: outline = era plans and overviews (few calls, best models); draft = event and entity pages (bulk); classify = RSS articles; verify = judge drafted claims against Wikipedia extracts (Gemini 2.5, the only free search-grounded models, is closed to new users). translate = Traditional Chinese versions: Chinese-native OpenRouter free models first, then Gemma. video_text = summarise a video's own subtitles (text only, cheap). video = watch YouTube videos linked from RSS posts when there are no subtitles, or to compare with the subtitle summary (Gemini only; ~100 tokens/s at low resolution, so a 250K TPM model is needed). vision = read photos (Gemma first: large quota; a model that cannot take images is skipped per call). evidence = judge which archive/scholarly search results really relate to a page (OpenRouter's free budget first, then Gemma).
